studies.title: ATM signals to TSC2 in the cytoplasm to regulate mTORC1 in response to ROS
studies.finding:
Described a cytoplasmic job for the DNA-damage kinase ATM. In response to raised ROS, ATM activated TSC2 through LKB1 and AMPK, which repressed mTORC1 and induced autophagy. ATM-deficient cells had high ROS and poorly controlled mTORC1, and rapamycin lowered both and delayed lymphoma formation in Atm-deficient mice.

studies.title: A Tumor suppressor complex with GAP activity for the Rag GTPases that signal amino acid sufficiency to mTORC1
studies.finding: Found the OFF switch for amino acid signaling: the GATOR1 complex is a GAP that shuts the Rag GTPases (and thus mTORC1) down when amino acids run low, while GATOR2 opposes it.
